match_stages.stage_briefing:
START POSITION: Standing toes on marks, facing downrange, hands relaxed at sides.
Handgun: Loaded and holstered, arms hanging naturally at sides.
PCC: Loaded, stock touching belt, muzzle pointing downrange.

STAGE PROCEDURE: Upon start signal, engage targets as they become visible from within the shooting area. The drop turner is activated by opening the door; it is not visible while at rest. Best two hits will score.

SCORING: Comstock
TARGETS: 9 USPSA Targets, Some No-Shoots
ROUNDS: 18 Rounds
START-STOP: Audible Signal / Last Shot
